description: Release a submitted escrow to the seller after checking the delivery. Works for Stripe/off-chain escrows only: the buyer releases, or, if the escrow names an evaluator, only that evaluator can. On-chain (ERC-8183) escrows, including every marketplace job funded through award_intent, are refused here: the buyer completes them with POST /v1/commerce/jobs/<chain>/<jobId>/complete (the refusal message names the exact path) and the contract pays the seller.
name: release_escrow
